    05 FAQ

    Good to know.

    How much is a haircut?

    Skin fades are $35, tapers and classic cuts $30, and kids cuts $25. Every price is listed in the barber section above.

    Where are you located?

    10 King St E in downtown Kitchener, close to the LRT and easy to reach from anywhere in Kitchener-Waterloo.

    Do I need to book?

    Booking online guarantees your chair and your time. Walk-ins get the next free chair.

    Can I get a cut and shop in the same visit?

    That's the idea. Browse the rack before or after your cut, and ask us to hold a size when you book.

    How does "Hold my size" work?

    Pick the item and your size, leave your name and number, and we'll set it aside for when you come in.

    Can you print shirts for a team or event?

    Yes. Bring your design, the quantities and sizes, and we'll put the order together.
